system.description:
1st Level Clan Feature

Your body stores Nature Energy, a raw and volatile force of energy that you accumulate involuntarily when in the heat of combat. You have a maximum of 1 + your proficiency bonus Nature Energy. When you complete a long rest, you reset your Nature energy to 0. You cannot accumulate Nature Energy outside of combat, but it does persist from encounter to encounter. You gain 1 Nature Energy per trigger, per turn, from the following:

You deal damage to a hostile creature.

You take damage from a hostile creature.

You begin your turn within 10 feet of a hostile creature.

You can spend this accumulated Nature Energy on the following during combat. You can activate one Expenditure per turn.

Amplify. Jugo Clan Hijutsu you cast gains its Amplified effect by spending the listed Nature Energy.

Heal. As an Action, you can spend up to 4 Nature Energy. When you do, select one allied creature other than yourself that you can touch. That creature regains 1d6 hit points for every Nature Energy spent. Beginning at 11th level, increase the number of Nature Energy you can spend to 6.
